_comment: RDPeek's known-bad graphics-driver advisory list. Community-maintained — open a PR to add or correct entries. RDPeek fetches the raw copy of this file from GitHub at runtime (falling back to the copy embedded in the build) and warns when a client- or server-side display adapter matches. Matching: an entry applies to a GPU when the GPU's Name contains 'vendor' (and 'match' if set), case-insensitive, and 'side' is client/server/both. A driver version is flagged if it is listed in 'badVersions' or falls inside 'range' [min,max] inclusive. Versions compare as dotted-numeric (e.g. 31.0.15.3623). Separately, any driver older than 'oldDriverMonths' gets a quiet, low-severity 'old driver' note.

entries.reason: This NVIDIA driver family has reports of black screens / freezes decoding RDP H.264 (AVC 4:4:4).
Reported RDP client rendering corruption / gray screen with hardware H.264 decode in this Adrenalin range.
